decisionsTitle: A simple volunteer agreement, approved by the club and accepted by every volunteer
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13 ~23:20, right after the volunteers shipped (§754):** «trebuie să avem și un document gen „contract de voluntariat” simplu, unde zicem că nu sunt plătiți, că trebuie să respecte atribuțiunile, bla bla bla». Romania's volunteering law (Legea nr. 78/2014) asks for a written agreement between the host organisation and each volunteer; §754 listed people with nothing signed. Amends §754.

**Decision.** A seventh legal text of the platform, `VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT` («Contract de voluntariat» / “Volunteer agreement”), built and approved exactly as the declarations are (§29, §95, §418, §515, §639): a Romanian and an English template in `legal-documents/templates/volunteer-agreement.ts`, the club named only by its four `<PLACEHOLDER>`s (§132), «Regenerează din șablon» and the one press on `/admin/legal`, a version fixed by its hash, the sample banner everywhere but production (the seed approves a sample on dev and QA, and is still refused production), the «Șablon nou» email of §639 when the template moves. Its words, plain: the parties; the activity — the event, its date and place, the role and what it asks; unpaid, no employment, costs announced beforehand are not pay; the volunteer's duties (the role's tasks, the organizers' instructions, safety and the event's rules, the confidentiality of the participants' data seen at the desk, telling the organizers when they cannot come); the club's duties (information about the role and its risks, the means, a contact on the day, a volunteer certificate on request); duration; ending by either side at any time; a pointer to the privacy notice; Legea nr. 78/2014. One text serves every event and role: `{{volunteer}}`, `{{volunteerRole}}`, `{{volunteerTasks}}` (a role with no description leaves its sentence out), `{{event}}`, `{{eventDate}}`, `{{eventLocation}}`, `{{minimumAge}}` and `{{signedAt}}` are filled when a person accepts.

**Accepted before listed, three ways.** (1) **The public form** «Vreau să fiu voluntar» opens only while an agreement is in force in every language — a fourth condition, `noAgreement`, after the notice's (`volunteerOfferClosedFor`; the card names it, the action asks again) — and takes two more required ticks: «Am citit și accept contractul de voluntariat», linking the text in force at `/legal/volunteer-agreement` in a new tab, and «Am cel puțin 18 ani». (2) **A person an organizer enters by hand** is «Contract neacceptat încă» on the card until they accept: «Trimite linkul contractului» queues one email whose single-use link is minted at the send (AGENTS.md §12.8, §14.5): only its SHA-256 is kept, on the volunteer's row, with its expiry (the house's 14 days); a newer email's link replaces it, a changed address or a cancellation kills it; the link's page reads and never writes, and its button spends the link in the same statement that records the acceptance. (3) **On paper at the desk**: «PDF de semnat» prints the agreement filled for the person with the volunteer's and the organizer's signature lines; «Semnat pe hârtie», after a question, records it with the staff member who recorded it — a record of the person's signature, never a signature given for them. Every way keeps the same facts on the row (migration `0148_volunteer_agreement`, expand only): the version accepted (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`, and counted among `/admin/legal`'s signatures so a version somebody accepted is never edited or removed as unused), the moment, the way, the language, the blanks as filled (`agreement_facts`, so a role renamed later never changes what was accepted) and the SHA-256 of the exact text read (§556's `signedTextHash`), with the age declared.

**The PDF.** Drawn by the signed declaration's renderer (§95, §515), no identity document asked: the accepted text, the name in the hand the page showed it in, how and when it was accepted and the two fingerprints; attached to the volunteer's «am primit» after the form and to «Ai acceptat contractul de voluntariat» after the link, and downloadable from the card (audited, like the declaration's). The privacy notice's template names the acceptance in its volunteers' paragraph (kept to conclude and perform the agreement, art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). `/admin/tasks` gains the row `volunteerAgreement`: open while an event ahead takes volunteers and no agreement is in force, done by itself once one is.

**For the lawyer, not decided here:** whether an electronic acceptance meets the law's written form or the paper copy is needed; minors (15–18 may volunteer with a parent's consent — the platform takes adults only until the lawyer says how); whether the role's description is enough as the task sheet; insurance; and whether a register of agreements must outlive the thirty-day deletion of the volunteers' rows (§754), which takes the acceptances with it.

**Refused.** A confirmation blocked until the agreement is accepted (the brief asks for the mark, and blocking would stop the club's list in production the day this ships, before any text is approved); an acceptance on a repeated public sign-up (a stranger could accept for a listed address — the link to that address is the way); a token in `email_action_tokens` (it requires a participant, and a volunteer is none: the hash lives on the volunteer's row instead).
changelogLine: - **A volunteer agreement («Contract de voluntariat»)** — a new legal text the club approves in «Documente legale» from the platform's template: unpaid help, what the volunteer and the club each do, ending at any time, Legea nr. 78/2014. «Vreau să fiu voluntar» opens only while it is in force and asks to accept it and «Am cel puțin 18 ani»; a person entered by hand is «Contract neacceptat încă» until they accept from an emailed single-use link or sign the printed copy at the desk; the accepted agreement comes as a PDF by email and from the card. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event that takes volunteers, when no volunteer agreement is in force in every language, then its page draws no «Vreau să fiu voluntar» and a post is refused (`CONFLICT`); once one is, the form also requires «Am citit și accept contractul de voluntariat» (linking the text in force in a new tab) and «Am cel puțin 18 ani», each refusal named at its box, and a kept offer records the version accepted, the moment, `FORM`, the language, the blanks as filled and the SHA-256 of the filled text (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the legal document keys, then `VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT` is the seventh, last in the enum and on `/admin/legal` in a group of its own, approved by the one press with the others; the seed approves a sample of it everywhere but production; and a version a volunteer accepted counts among its signatures and cannot be deleted under them (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`) (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the volunteer agreement's template, then in both languages it says the help is unpaid and no employment, the volunteer's duties and the club's, that either side may end it at any time, points to the privacy notice and names Legea nr. 78/2014; it carries the club's four facts as placeholders and the merge fields `{{volunteer}}`, `{{volunteerRole}}`, `{{volunteerTasks}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{eventDate}}`, `{{eventLocation}}`, `{{minimumAge}}`, `{{signedAt}}`, a role without a description leaving out the sentence that names it (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer entered by hand, when an organizer presses «Trimite linkul contractului», then one email is queued with no secret in it and the link is minted when it is sent, its SHA-256 alone on the volunteer's row; its page reads and writes nothing; accepting spends it in the statement that records the acceptance (`LINK`), so a second use, an expired link, a link a newer email replaced, one sent to an address changed since and one of a cancelled volunteer all answer the same «no longer valid» (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event's «Voluntari» card, then each person says «Contract acceptat» with the version, the way and the moment, or «Contract neacceptat încă» with «Trimite linkul contractului», «PDF de semnat» and «Semnat pe hârtie», which records the version in force and the staff member who recorded it; the card names «niciun contract de voluntariat nu e în vigoare» as the reason the public form is closed, and `/admin/tasks` shows the row `volunteerAgreement` while an event ahead takes volunteers and none is in force (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer, when their agreement is downloaded from the card or attached to their «am primit» or to «Ai acceptat contractul de voluntariat», then the PDF prints the accepted text with its blanks as accepted, the name, how and when it was accepted and the text's fingerprint — or, not accepted yet, the text in force filled for them with the volunteer's and the organizer's signature lines — and never an identity-document line (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the volunteer agreement's verbs — «Trimite linkul contractului», «Semnat pe hârtie» and the PDF route — when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator asks, then the server refuses (`FORBIDDEN` / 403), and a volunteer of another event is `NOT_FOUND` (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
